acceptance_predicates.description: Installed launch receives a versioned endpoint, channel, manifest/source digests, and workspace/state roots.
Persisted handoff reloads across restart and rejects incompatible or tampered records.
Failed update preserves the previous known-good frontend and reports a human-readable diagnostic.
Missing authentication, signatures and key management remain visible warnings and never block development launch.
Exact protected-main merge and all required hosted/exact-main checks are recorded in the receipt.

definition_of_done: Merged exact-main implementation passes handoff, restart, tamper and rollback tests.
Post-merge receipt records exact protected-main head and independent review evidence.

inputs.description: Current protected asb-tui main with adapter and defaults support.

outputs.description: Versioned, persisted and validated installed frontend handoff consumed by launch.

gates.description: All required PR and exact-main checks pass on merged head.
